title: English Word Pronunciation Practice Coach
problem: Telugu medium students in our hostel feel shy to speak in town interviews because they get stuck pronouncing long English words.
idea: A kind pronunciation coach. It listens to a word and gives encouraging feedback. Here, tap what the coach 'heard' and practise words by breaking them into small parts.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What did the coach hear?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine Audio listens to the word 'Communication'. Tap a result.
widgets.question: You said 'Communication'. The coach heard:

options.label: Clear word
options.result: Excellent! Com-mu-ni-CA-tion. You said it clearly. Try a new word!

options.label: Stuck in the middle
options.result: Good try! Say it slowly in parts: com – mu – ni – CA – tion. Stress on CA.

options.label: Too soft
options.result: I can't hear you well. Speak a little louder. You can do it!

items.text: Said 5 new words slowly in parts
Spoke 3 sentences in English to a friend
Practised my self-introduction in front of a mirror
items.te: అద్దం ముందు నా పరిచయం సాధన చేశాను

bands.text: Brilliant practice! Keep going every day. 🌟
Start with just 1 word today. Small steps!

how: Ask Gemini for 10 common interview words, broken into syllables.
Open Teachable Machine and choose Audio Project.
Record Background Noise, then record the class 'Communication' with many friends saying it clearly.
Train, Export and copy the model link.
In Scratch with TM2Scratch, make the sprite say 'Excellent!' when the word is heard clearly.
Practise every evening in the hostel with friends.
prompt: I am a Class 8 Telugu medium student. Give me 10 long English words used in job interviews. Break each into syllables, show the stressed part in capitals, and give a Telugu sound guide.
